description.narrative:
The objective of the programme is to improve the innovative eco-system and boost start-ups creation.
This result area is focused on the establishment of an Albanian Innovation Challenge Fund as a means of addressing the issue of access to finance for innovative companies at an early stage of development, as well as for organisations engaged in services to innovative start-ups and promotion of the Albanian innovation system. The fund builds on the idea that both start-ups and innovation service providers receive capacity building through various forms of technical assistance under Result area 1 and 2 (implemented by GIZ). The Challenge Fund would provide funding to the most promising companies to carry them through the valley of death and scale up their innovative businesses. The fund would also provide funding to the best innovation service providers to upgrade their capacity further and/or develop new services to the innovation and start-up community in Albania.
It is expected by the end of the programme to have improvements in the scores of pillar 12 ''innovation'' and sub-pillar ''Capacity for Innovation'' of the Global Competitivenss Index. To Strengthening capacity for innovation among the innovation system actors (start-ups, innovation support organizations and policy-makers). To Build linkages within the Albanian innovation system and internationally with events, collaborations, facilitate access to internation networks etc. To have supported and created innovative startups , where at least 35% are women led. To have financial supported Startups and Innovation service providers, up to 40 startups and 10 women led.

Insatsen är en del av programmet ''Improving Albania Eco-system and boosting start up creation in Albania'' som till stor del finansieras av Europeiska unionen. I september 2018 fattade Sidas generaldirektör beslut om att Sida ska ta emot 2 200 000 EUR från EU för genomförandet av programmet. Även avtalet mellan Sida och EU-kommissionen undertecknades i september 2018. Sidas stöd till programmet, som den här insatsen omfattar, täcker 10% av den totala programkostnaden.
Det övergripande målet för programmet är att bidra till bättre kvalitet och hållbar turism samt ökad ekonomisk tillväxt och konkurrenskraft i regioner i Albanien. Målet med insatsen är att förbättra förutsättningar för innovation och stödja bildandet av nya företag.
Målet med etableringen av en albansk ”Innovation Challenge Fund” (”fonden”) för innovativa företag och organisationer som arbetar med stöd till innovation är att de ska få tillgång till finansiering i ett tidigt stadium. Genom etableringen av fonden får nya företag och organisationer som jobbar med innovationstjänster kompetensutveckling genom olika typer av teknisk assistans. Fonden avser att ge stöd till de mest lovande företagen i uppstartsfasen och ge möjlighet till att skala upp deras verksamheter. Fonden avser vidare att ge stöd till de bästa organisationerna som arbetar med innovationstjänster för att stärka deras kapacitet samt för att utveckla nya tjänster för innovation i Albanien.
Det svenska bidraget ska finanseria en svensk konsult som kommer att anställas genom direkt upphandling för att hjälpa till med att etablera fonden. De bilaterala medlen kommer även att användas till finansiering av en utvärderingskommitté som kommer att inrättas för att utvärdera ansökningarna. Svenska utvärderare kommer att väljas utifrån en tidigare kartläggning av relevanta innovationsinstitutioner för programmet.

This contribution is part of the programme funded by the European Union Delegation to Albania ''Improving Albania Eco-system and boosting start up creation''. A general director decision was taken to receive EU funds of 2 200 000 EUR for the implementation of this programme.The agreement with the EU commision was signed in September 2018.
The overall objective is to enhance the contribution of high quality and sustainable tourism to economic growth and competitiveness of Albanian regions.
The specific objective of the programme is to improve the innovative eco-system and boost start-ups creation.
This result area is focused on the establishment of an Albanian Innovation Challenge Fund as a means of addressing the issue of access to finance for innovative companies at an early stage of development, as well as for organisations engaged in services to innovative start-ups and promotion of the Albanian innovation system. The fund builds on the idea that both start-ups and innovation service providers receive capacity building through various forms of technical assistance under Result area 1 and 2 (implemented by GIZ). The Challenge Fund would provide funding to the most promising companies to carry them through the ‘valley of death’ and scale up their innovative businesses. The fund would also provide funding to the best innovation service providers to upgrade their capacity further and/or develop new services to the innovation and start-up community in Albania.
The bilateral funds will cover 10% of the programme cost. A Swedish consultant will be hired under a direct procurement in order to assist with setting up the challenge fund. To evaluate the proposals an evaluation committe will be set up. Swedish evaluators will be selected based on a previous mapping of the relevant Innovation Institutions for this programme.

The Action/EU initiative 'Improve the Innovative Ecosystem and boost start-ups creation in Albania' was an output of the request sent to the Embassy by EU Delegation to Albania to submit a letter of interest under Sector II: IPA 2017 Competitiveness and Innovation Action II: EU Support to a tourism-led model for local economic development Component III: Innovation. EU Delegation retained both SIDA and GIZ entities as being capable of implementing the component in a professional manner with the suggestion for the following set up: GIZ as Main Delegatee and Sida as Co-Delegatee.
The total budget for this action funded by the Delegation of the European Union to Albania at the total amount of 6,6 MEUR. The Embassy of Sweden in Tirana received 2,2MEUR and added 0,22 MEUR from its bilateral budget.
The overall objective of the Action was to improve the innovation ecosystem with an emphasis on supporting startups and entrepreneurship.
Sida was responsible for Results Area (RA) 3: Funding innovative startups and innovation support providers. Under result area 3, Sida, The Swedish Embassy in Albania, was responsible for the establishment and management of the Challenge Fund grant facility.
The Innovation Challenge Fund has provided funding to two groups of beneficiaries: (i) Start-ups no older than 3 years, based on their registration date at the National Business Center, and (ii) Innovation Supporting Organizations (ISOs) at least 1 year old, based on their registration date in court. Under the start-up window, three categories of funds were provided: Idea-stage start-ups received up to 7,000 EUR, early-stage start-ups received up to 15,000 EUR, and scale-up start-ups received up to 25,000 EUR. ISOs could receive grants of up to 100,000 EUR. For both start-ups and ISOs supported by the Challenge Fund, a mandatory principle of 50% cost-sharing was applied.
Grantees were selected through a competitive and transparent system. The entire process, including application and evaluation, was conducted digitally through the Challenge Fund's online platform (euforinnovation.al). Applicants submitted their applications electronically. The assessment process involved a scoring system and encompassed five stages: Management Team: Assessed the innovation level within the Albanian context. Financial Advisory Team: Reviewed the financial aspects of the proposal. Swedish Evaluation Committee: Analyzed the commercial potential and sustainability of the proposal.Validation Bootcamp: Evaluated the team's dedication, involvement, and expertise during presentations. Legal Advisory Team: Conducted due diligence on the start-ups and organizations. Applications were selected based on the uniqueness of the business concept within the Albanian context, its innovative character, potential for rapid growth, ability to generate employment, and the likelihood of sustainability and growth post-funding.
The Challenge Fund launched four rounds of calls for proposals, receiving and evaluating a total of 660 applications515 from start-ups (229 male-led and 220 female-led) and 145 from ISOs (90 male-led and 55 female-led). Overall, the Challenge Fund awarded 40 grants, comprising 33 start-ups and 7 ISOs. Out of these 40 grants, 17 were awarded to women-led initiatives. The beneficiaries span a broad range across Albania, encompassing 10 different cities: Tirana, Shkodra, Saranda, Korça, Kruja, Has, Pogradec, Berat, Dibër, and Durrës. List of Challenge Fund beneficiaries (startups): E-Business Solution - Online ticket sales application for cultural, sports, tourism, and other types of events and activities. Bleta Saffron - Cultivation of organic certified saffron. PI - Software system for schools serving three end-users: teachers, students, and parents. Nena Farm - Eco-sustainable production of olive oil from century old olive trees with an innovative packaging to be exported to the Canadian and EU market. Mussel Tour - A personal tour experience exploring different aspects of mussel farming such as growing, harvesting and tasting. Alpine Bees - Sustainable and innovative production of honey through innovative technology. Corn Maze- Corn maze attraction with a park farm for family activities in open air. Real Bookers - Hotel Management service software. GO2 - Innovation Supporting Organization that supports startups in the field of tourism / hospitality and agriculture in the northern region of the country. Future University - Innovation Supporting Organization that supports startups in the field of innovation within smart city engineering and sustainable constructions and architecture- Establishment of Innovation Hub. Donkey Farm - 1st Donkey Farm in Albania. Certified production of donkey milk & side products. Innovation in Tradition - Handcraft of silk products by empowering women and transferring the know-how from older generations to new ones. Thurje Handmade - Production of traditional textile products handmade by artisan women of Korça and designed by contemporary young Albanian designers. Ani Ahmetaj - Drones to combat processionary caterpillars. Drini Times - Innovative touristic tours (birdwatching, paddling, kayaki) offered around Shkodra lake. Pikark - Digital platform dedicated to architecture and design. LikSad E-Bike - E-bike tours with audio-guide & storytelling (voicemap). 12 Vite - Learning platform for students in Primary School and in High School. Regional Development Agency (RDA) - Innovation Support Organisation with a focus on precise Agriculture in Korça/Smart Agriculture Application & Platform. Polis University - Establishment of 1st Innovation Factory in Albania an open space to co-innovate for prototyping, digital fabrication and smart innovations in the field of urban design and architecture, serving the WB region. Active Albania - Innovative pack-rafting tours Innovative pack-rafting tours. Gabrielle Mazza - Innovative aluminium junction constructions to simplify the industrial aluminium constructions, to shorten the construction time and to reutilize the structure reconstructing it elsewhere. Ferma Jone - Process innovation and recycling of farm products for a No Waste farm. Kamberi Handcraft - Show room museum and E-commerce of top-quality handcrafted products from Has. Shpernda - Eco-friendly delivery service through e-bikes. An innovative e-mobility solution promoting a healthy lifestyle which protects the environment by reducing dependence on fossil fuels. Zaharia Parc - Treehouse Park in Kruja region using natural resources and creation of a sustainable cycle in terms of resource utilization. Medical Distribution - The First endoscopy and Ultrasound Service laboratory in the Balkans. Nji Mar, Nji Mrapsht - Creative industries Incubator Platfrom. Immortelle - Cultivation of medicinal and aromatic plants in Albania with the aim to give farmers a chance to export their products abroad. Albanian Parcel Distribution - Delivery services, Innovative warehouse that aims reduce transport speed by 50%. Akademi.al - Online Market Place for education. Funky Creative - Glamping - a new way of camping in woody hand-made cabins that meet every need in all seasons. Bees and Trees Biocosmetics - The first albanian brand for Eco-friendly and sustainable skin-care products. Tracked - Application for contract-monitoring, time tracking and billing for companies. Orkestra - E-commerce platform for mechanical auto parts. Ozzo.al - Digital Ordering platform for HoReCa industry, introducing digital menus through QR-Codes. Brick Plast - Recycling company that converts three categories of material waste (plastic, paper, and cardboard) into innovative products (fuels, furniture and building materials). Legit - Digital legal platform which facilitates business professionals, entrepreneurs, freelancers to find legal services. Division 5 - A dedicated platform/ hub for Albanian software developers. Helius Systems - E commerce platform targeting farmers (Farm to Fork) to support them in developing business solutions that guarantee their sustainable growth.
Through the Challenge Fund, Sida addressed a critical gap in financing innovative ideas, thereby contributing to the growth of the innovation ecosystem in Albania. Entrepreneurs achieved significant results, including success in modeling and bringing their innovative ideas to market, expanding or diversifying their businesses, which resulted in the expansion of financial portfolios and job creation in supported businesses.
